message: `result(lent)` on `top` is not a claim the compiler reads
label: not `owned`
notes: `result(owned)` says a type-variable result carries a share the caller must release; codegen acts on it, so a value it does not know is refused rather than ignored
help: write `;@axiom:result(owned)`, the one value this key takes

message: `result(owned)` on `first` is a claim only a trusted function may make
label: safe code claims it
notes: the checker cannot see that a share was transferred through a raw load, so the claim is accepted only inside a trusted encapsulation (MM-LIFE-2n)
help: put `;@axiom:effect(unsafe)` beside it on the same declaration, or let the result's ownership be inferred
